purpose: Transparent regression probes for lexical routing boundaries across global and repository-scoped skills.
construction: The original corpus was independently authored before the 2026-08-08 router hardening without copying lifecycle-evaluations.json wording. New-skill boundary probes are added when ownership changes. After adoption every case is a development regression, not a blind or behavioral evaluation.
proof_boundary: Routable cases test deterministic ranking against the complete stored names and descriptions. They do not prove that a host includes every skill, preserves full descriptions within its metadata budget, abstains correctly, selects semantically, follows pressure contracts, or uses tools safely; those boundaries require actual-host discovery and separate behavioral evaluation.
